data_objects.name: call_center_intervals
data_objects.meaning: Time-interval records of call handling activity and agent staffing at a call center.
data_objects.notes: Count and average fields describe the interval identified by timestamp; the precise operational definitions are not supplied.

variables.name: timestamp
variables.meaning: Start or label time of the reporting interval.

variables.name: num. busy overflows
variables.meaning: Number of calls recorded as busy overflows during the interval.

variables.name: num. calls answered
variables.meaning: Number of calls answered during the interval.

variables.name: num. calls abandoned
variables.meaning: Number of calls abandoned during the interval.

variables.name: num. calls transferred
variables.meaning: Number of calls transferred during the interval.

variables.name: num. calls timed out
variables.meaning: Number of calls that timed out during the interval.

variables.name: avg. num. agents talking
variables.meaning: Average number of agents engaged in calls during the interval.

variables.name: avg. num. agents staffed
variables.meaning: Average number of staffed agents during the interval.

variables.name: avg. wait time
variables.meaning: Average caller wait duration for the interval, encoded as HH:MM:SS.

variables.name: avg. abandonment time
variables.meaning: Average elapsed duration before abandonment for the interval, encoded as HH:MM:SS.

structure.description: Each row represents an apparent 15-minute reporting interval, identified and chronologically ordered by timestamp.

uncertainties: The table does not define whether timestamp marks the start or end of an interval.
The population of calls and agents covered by the report is not identified.
annotation_notes: Meanings are based only on the source column names, values, and encodings visible in train.csv.
